meta.title: Luna Sync — Track Your Cycle in Harmony with the Moon
meta.description: Luna Sync helps you understand your menstrual cycle through the lens of lunar phases. Privacy-first, medically-informed, beautifully minimal.

hero.title: Live in sync with the moon.
hero.subtitle: Luna Sync maps your cycle to lunar phases — revealing your inner seasons with privacy-first intelligence.
hero.trust: Your data never leaves your device. End-to-end encrypted.

items.title: Moon Phase Tracking
items.desc: See how your cycle aligns with the 8 lunar phases. Luna Sync maps your personal data against the moon's journey — new moon to full, and back again.

items.title: The Inner Seasons
items.desc: Your cycle has four distinct seasons: Inner Spring (follicular), Summer (ovulatory), Autumn (luteal), Winter (menstrual). Luna Sync helps you understand each phase and plan accordingly.

items.title: Private by Design
items.desc: All health data is encrypted and stored locally on your device. No cloud sync, no accounts, no tracking. You own your cycle, completely.

items.q: Is my menstrual cycle really linked to the moon?
items.a: While individual cycles vary, research suggests a statistical correlation between lunar phases and menstrual onset. A 2021 study in *Science Advances* found that periods often synchronize with the new or full moon. Luna Sync helps you explore this connection with your own data.

items.q: How does Luna Sync protect my health data?
items.a: All data is encrypted using AES-256 and stored exclusively on-device. Luna Sync has no servers, no cloud storage, and no analytics SDKs. We do not collect, share, or sell any personal information — ever.

items.q: What are the 'Inner Seasons' of the menstrual cycle?
items.a: The menstrual cycle is commonly divided into four phases: Inner Spring (follicular phase — energy rises), Summer (ovulation — peak energy), Autumn (luteal phase — energy recedes), and Winter (menstruation — rest and reflection). Luna Sync visualizes your cycle through this seasonal lens.

items.q: Can Luna Sync predict my next period?
items.a: Yes. Using your logged data, Luna Sync applies a predictive algorithm based on your cycle history. Predictions improve over time as you log more cycles. All computation happens on-device.

items.q: Is Luna Sync a medical device or contraceptive tool?
items.a: No. Luna Sync is a wellness and education tool. It is not FDA-cleared, not a medical device, and should not be used as a contraceptive method. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical decisions.

items.q: What is 'Cyclical Living' and how does Luna Sync support it?
items.a: Cyclical Living means aligning your daily life with your natural hormonal rhythms rather than fighting them. Luna Sync helps you identify your high-energy and restorative phases so you can plan work, exercise, and social activities optimally. Research suggests cycle-syncing can improve productivity by up to 30% and reduce stress.

items.q: Can I use Luna Sync without an internet connection?
items.a: Yes, Luna Sync works fully offline. After the initial download, no internet connection is required — all features including tracking, prediction, and moon phase visualization run locally on your device. Your data is never transmitted to any external server.

items.q: How is Luna Sync different from other cycle tracking apps?
items.a: Most cycle trackers send your data to the cloud. Luna Sync is different: all data remains on your device (local-first architecture). We have no servers, no analytics SDKs, and require no account. Combined with the unique moon phase visualization and inner seasons framework, Luna Sync offers a truly private and holistic experience.

privacy_manifesto.title: Why Privacy Matters
privacy_manifesto.text: Your health data belongs to you. Most cycle tracking apps send intimate health data to external servers — some even sell it to advertisers. Luna Sync was built differently: everything stays on your device. We use AES-256 encryption, no cloud accounts, no analytics SDKs, no data collection. Luna Sync doesn't need an internet connection to function — download once and it works fully offline. Your body, your data, your iPhone.

items.def: Aligning daily activities with natural hormonal rhythms across the menstrual cycle.
The four phases of the menstrual cycle visualized as Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter.
Mapping menstrual cycle data against the 8 lunar phases (new moon to full moon and back).
Architecture where all user data is processed and stored on-device with no cloud transmission.
